title: Historical Foundation and Cross-Sport Candidate Freeze
objective: Establish a leakage-safe historical foundation for WNBA full-game winner probability before any Elite threshold discovery, coefficient retuning, cross-sport promotion, or outcome-driven candidate switching.

scientificScope.reasonSpreadTotalExcluded: Current spread and total probability-like outputs are heuristic transformations and are not the clean binary winner probability required by the cross-sport ranker.

frozenPrimaryCandidate.definition: Exact current predictWNBA sports logit through sigmoid and the frozen +/-2.0 logit cap, evaluated with marketImpliedHomeProb omitted.

frozenDeployedControl.definition: Exact deployed WNBA probability: SPORTS_ONLY_V1 blended 65% with the raw implied HOME probability from the HOME moneyline, plus the existing extreme-gap sanity pull and final [0.05,0.95] clamp.
frozenDeployedControl.extremeGapRule: If abs(sportsProb-marketProb) >= 0.25 and sportsProb >= 0.80 or <= 0.20, average the 65/35 blend with marketProb + gap*0.40.
frozenDeployedControl.reason: The common cross-sport winner signal must not gain an undeclared advantage from sportsbook information when other sport-specific candidate probabilities are sports-information-only.

historicalReplay.seasonPolicy: Use the five complete seasons only if all required pre-tip fields can be reconstructed without future information. A season or row failing exact custody is excluded transparently, never imputed from future/current state.
historicalReplay.2026Use: PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION_ONLY_AFTER_R1_FREEZE; no 2026 settled outcomes may be used to tune R1 coefficients, thresholds, gates, or candidate identity.

missingDataPolicy.rule: A field may be absent only where the frozen live model itself treats that field as optional and the historical reconstruction proves that omission reflects information availability at that pre-tip timestamp. Otherwise the row is ineligible for exact replay.

evaluationProtocol.note: R1 certifies the probability foundation. High-accuracy selective Elite rules, if scientifically justified, are a later preregistered phase and may not be mined in R1.

decisionPolicy.ifPrimaryFailsProbabilityGates: WNBA cross-sport probability remains BLOCKED; create a separately versioned future research phase rather than retuning R1 after outcomes.
decisionPolicy.ifPrimaryPassesProbabilityGates: Freeze SPORTS_ONLY_V1 as the WNBA base p_win_selected_side candidate; this alone does not authorize Global Elite Ranker promotion or betting.

r1ExitCriteria: Historical pre-tip input availability audit completed without opening outcomes
At least 500 eligible games across five complete seasons with at least 80 eligible games per season
Outcomes opened exactly once after rowset freeze
SPORTS_ONLY_V1 scored against all preregistered probability gates
CURRENT_65_35_V1 reported only as the deployed market-informed control
No production model, coefficient, threshold, recommendation, staking, or global ranking change
